description: Free: given an exact Scry product id from scry_catalog (e.g. wallet_address_quick_flag, wallet_address_forensics, solana_hot_wallets_daily) plus a wallet or mint where required, return the exact x402 endpoint URL, price, and payment instructions. The calling agent pays this URL directly with its own x402/USDC wallet — this bridge never custodies funds. Call scry_catalog first if you do not know the exact id.

address.description: Solana wallet address (base58, 32-44 chars) for wallet-scoped products

address_b.description: Second Solana wallet address for pairwise products (wallet connection)

mint.description: Solana mint address (base58, 32-44 chars) for mint-scoped products

product.description: Exact product id from scry_catalog. Ambiguous fragments are rejected with a candidate list.

name: scry_paid_endpoint
title: Resolve a paid Scry x402 endpoint (free; payment happens agent-side)
